title_zh: 约定重写虚构疫情图表的标题

scenario.label_zh: 限定虚构疫情报道标题的证据范围
scenario.goal_zh: 区分新增报告数与现存病例总数，并约定删去夸大疫情已经结束的标题

context_zh: 媒体分析课堂中，两名学生检查虚构疫情案例的一张每周报告图表。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: The case study describes an epidemic, but the last point on this chart is much lower. Can our headline say it is over?

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: No. The chart shows new reports each week, not the total number of people still ill.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: I do not want to exaggerate the improvement, but we should acknowledge the drop.

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: Of course. Saying there were fewer new reports in the final week would not distort what the chart actually shows.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: Shall we use that as the headline and add that the chart cannot tell us whether transmission has stopped?

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: Yes. Replace "Epidemic over" with the narrower statement, and keep the dates from the chart.
